scope: Probe readout fit/validation/test episodes are disjoint. Selected probe/prediction windows are excluded from both original encoder training window splits, but may share episodes/frames with other training windows. Not encoder-episode-heldout or globally untouched.
action_normalization_scope: Original recipes global-dataset mean/sample std in original H5 dtype, normalize before conversion to FP32 and five-action flattening; kept fixed, not claimed train-only
calibration_scope: Intersection of both encoder-training window sets, restricted to probe-fit episodes; excludes all probe validation/test episodes
